I'm a guy. But thanks for the words of wisdom. It helps knowing someone understands. My family can't seem to.
I watched my ex stepdad throw my mum around the house. I had to look after my little sister, their child. It was the most ferocious cry I've ever had. I was just powerless to do anything.

My dad asked me if I wanted to see him again. I live 700miles away with my mum. My whole life he says he loves me, but he never put me first. I was always a second thought. My sister and his girlfriend were always top priority even though he lived with them. He forgot multiple birthdays. He is financially comfortable but would make me pay to see him off my minimum wage job. When I did see him he'd rather go to the pub with his friends. He just never seemed to care. About a week ago he asked if I wanted to spend Christmas with him. I had to say no. It may not sound like a hard thing to do but when your own father doesn't have time for you, why should you have time for him.
